items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Grant and Wilson. A lot of funny calls. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Butterbeens and Susie was big.

ctx.x: Now that's a... Larry, one time I used to hear some people say they wouldn't go at the lake. Really? Uh-huh. But the palace, yeah, they always go at the pass. But Larry used to have all the, what you call the... Before the dance, you know, before the dance. Because I went there one night. One day I could call myself. Go to it there. You know, respect. Everything was just right. But the thing they said there, when I come here, I told my mother about it. She give us that laugh. She said, what if that's where you…
Yeah, I know what you're talking about. Like Butterbeens and Susie? You never saw them, huh? Grant and Wilson. A lot of funny calls. Yeah.
Butterbeens and Susie was big. Male and female. Male and male.
